'''Cat Ceder''' (also written '''Cat Cedar''') was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Rogue 14 in the Alderaan region, from Santa Barbara, CA.<ref name="decsq-alderaan" /><ref name="smlist" />

Ceder learned the game at its release alongside [[Kevin Reitzel]] (Bravo Leader), with help from [[Kyle Heuer]] (Rogue Leader), and also played the Star Trek and Young Jedi games.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
